title: Corrected Closing Disclosures When a Mortgage Loan File Closing Date Moves
content:
**Standard.** When the closing date of a Mortgage Loan File that already has a Closing Disclosure moves before consummation, Larkspur issues a corrected Closing Disclosure that restates the borrower-paid nonrecurring closing costs for the scheduled closing date. The corrected Closing Disclosure carries the next disclosure sequence after the latest Closing Disclosure on the file, the changed circumstance that moved the closing (`borrower_requested_change` when the borrower asked for the new date) and the date that circumstance was documented.

**Fixing the figure.** The nonrecurring closing costs on a corrected Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge whose report is still within the credit report validity window on the scheduled closing date. Put the other way, while the file's fee ledger shows no credit report fee charge whose report is still within that window on the scheduled closing date, the nonrecurring closing costs on a corrected Closing Disclosure are not yet fixed.

| Element of the corrected Closing Disclosure | What it carries |
|---|---|
| Disclosure sequence | the next number after the latest Closing Disclosure on the file — for example 2 where only the initial Closing Disclosure exists, 3 where one correction already exists |
| Changed circumstance | the circumstance that moved the closing; a new date asked for by the borrower is a borrower-requested change |
| Documented date | the date that circumstance was documented |
| Nonrecurring closing costs | the restated figure for the scheduled closing date |

## Issuing tool: `issue_corrected_closing_disclosure_de3eb1f4`

**Capability.** Issues a corrected Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File before the loan is signed, restating the borrower-paid nonrecurring closing costs. One call adds one corrected Closing Disclosure to the file's disclosure history, dated today and sent to the borrower through the e-sign portal, carrying the sequence number, the changed-circumstance reason and its documented date, and the nonrecurring closing costs given; its receipt date stays empty until the borrower acknowledges it in the portal. The borrower can then open the corrected Closing Disclosure in the portal.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_corrected_closing_disclosure_de3eb1f4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `loan_file_id` — the reference number of the Mortgage Loan File the corrected Closing Disclosure is issued on, as returned by the loan file lookup.
- `disclosure_sequence` — the ordinal of this Closing Disclosure among the Closing Disclosures on the file (1 for the first, 2 for the first correction, and so on); an integer, no decimals.
- `coc_reason` — the changed circumstance the correction relies on, one of: `none` (no changed circumstance is relied on); `borrower_requested_change` (a change to the loan or the transaction that the borrower asked for); `rate_lock` (the rate was locked after a floating disclosure); `rate_lock_extension` (a lock extension the borrower requested); `relock` (a relock the borrower requested); `appraised_value_change` (the appraised value differs from the value on the application); `loan_amount_change` (the loan amount changed); `program_change` (the file moved to another loan program); `third_party_charge_increase_from_new_information` (a third-party charge rose because of new information about the borrower or the property); `delayed_settlement_over_60_days` (settlement on a new-construction purchase is delayed more than 60 days past the disclosed date).
- `coc_documented_date` — the date Larkspur received the information establishing the changed circumstance, as YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time, no time zone); an empty string where `coc_reason` is `none`.
- `nonrecurring_closing_costs` — the borrower-paid one-time closing costs disclosed on the corrected Closing Disclosure (Loan Costs sections A, B and C plus taxes and government fees, excluding discount points); US dollars, a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Corrected Closing Disclosure <disclosure id> issued on loan file <loan file id>: sequence <n>, changed circumstance <reason> documented <date>, nonrecurring closing costs <amount> USD, issued <YYYY-MM-DD> via esign_portal.", where the disclosure id is the new disclosure's reference number, the sequence, reason and date are the values passed in, the amount has 2 decimals and the issue date is today's date. Receiving this line means the corrected Closing Disclosure is on the file.
